name: MNRB
recent: MNRB 正在推进以 4 亿令吉收购 Labuan Reinsurance 80% 股权，因等待 Lloyd's 监管批准，交易截止日已延长至 2027 年 1 月 29 日。公司同时完成 2026 财年末期股息（每股 15 仙）的股息再投资计划，将发行 1,116 万股新股。最新季度净利同比下滑 14.8%，主要受投资未实现公允价值亏损影响。
notable: MNRB 与卖方同意将 Labuan Reinsurance 80% 股权收购的截止日从 2026 年 11 月 19 日延长至 2027 年 1 月 29 日，以等待 Lloyd's 监管批准。
MNRB 就 2026 财年末期股息每股 15 仙的股息再投资计划，将发行 11,163,612 股新股。
MNRB 宣布 Ahmad Noor Azhari Bin Abdul Manaf 自 2026 年 11 月 23 日起出任集团总裁，接替卸任的临时集团首席执行官 Dato' Rodzila @ Rudy Bin Che Lamin。
risks: Labuan Reinsurance 收购仍需取得 Lloyd's 监管批准，截止日已延长。
最新季度净利同比下滑 14.8%，主要因投资未实现公允价值亏损。
主要股东 Amanahraya Trustees Berhad（Amanah Saham Bumiputera）在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 8.365 亿令吉，环比增长 12.6%，同比微降 0.9%；净利为 1.838 亿令吉，环比增长 61.6%，同比增长 9.1%；净利率为 22.0%，高于上一季度的 15.3%。

recent_en: MNRB is proceeding with its RM400 million acquisition of an 80% stake in Labuan Reinsurance, with the cut-off date extended to 29 January 2027 pending Lloyd's regulatory approval. The company also completed the dividend reinvestment plan for its FY2026 final dividend of 15 sen per share, issuing 11.16 million new shares. Latest quarterly net profit fell 14.8% year-on-year, mainly due to unrealised fair value losses on investments.
notable_en: MNRB and the vendors agreed to extend the cut-off date for the acquisition of an 80% stake in Labuan Reinsurance from 19 November 2026 to 29 January 2027, pending Lloyd's regulatory approval.
MNRB will issue 11,163,612 new shares under the dividend reinvestment plan for its FY2026 final dividend of 15 sen per share.
MNRB announced the appointment of Ahmad Noor Azhari Bin Abdul Manaf as Group President effective 23 November 2026, succeeding Interim Group CEO Dato' Rodzila @ Rudy Bin Che Lamin.
risks_en: The Labuan Reinsurance acquisition still requires Lloyd's regulatory approval, and the cut-off date has been extended.
Latest quarterly net profit fell 14.8% year-on-year, mainly due to unrealised fair value losses on investments.
Substantial shareholder Amanahraya Trustees Berhad (Amanah Saham Bumiputera) filed multiple changes in shareholding between October and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM836.5 million, up 12.6% quarter-on-quarter and down 0.9% year-on-year; net income was RM183.8 million, up 61.6% quarter-on-quarter and 9.1% year-on-year; net margin was 22.0%, higher than 15.3% in the previous quarter.
